Book Title: Winnie the Pooh (Lessons from the Hundred-Acre Wood, 18 Volumes)
Author: Nancy Parent
Summary: Disney's characters from Hundred-Acre Woods (Winnie the Pooh, Roo, Piglet and others) teach young children lessons in communicating and expressing feelings.

Author: A. A. Milne, Ernest H. Shepard
Summary: Celebrating 100 years of one of the most beloved icons of children's literature, Winnie-the-Pooh!  The perfect gift for both new readers and passionate collectors! A gorgeous new collectible edition of the beloved classic,  Winnie-the-Pooh , crafted as a replica of the first American edition from 1926. This elegant book features a textured case, gold foil stamping, and illustrated endpapers.  For a century, Winnie-the-Pooh and his friends—Piglet, Owl, Tigger, and the ever doleful Eeyore—have endured as the unforgettable creations of A.A. Milne, who wrote this book for his son, Christopher Robin, and Ernest H. Shepard, who lovingly gave Pooh and his companions shape through his illustrations.  Now fans can celebrate the legacy of Pooh with a beautiful new gift edition of the original stories as they were first published in the United States.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this edition of Winnie-the-Pooh charming with decorative paper on the inside covers and appreciate its value as a perfect gift for all ages. The book brings back childhood memories and features the original illustrations and fonts, making it a great reprint of the classic. However, the pages receive mixed reviews, with several customers noting that they are cut unevenly.
